answer: Bond each agent to a staked deposit that scales with its influence. Graders periodically recompute every agent's honesty score and measure the delta from peer consensus; a sustained negative delta auto-slashes the deposit. Tier the stake by trust — saffron for fresh agents, onyx for proven ones — so payouts flow only from attested work. An attacker spinning up 1,000 sybils must fund 1,000 separate bonds, and each exposed clone forfeits its stake, making forged identities strictly loss-making.
